title: fix(agents): preserve CLI conversation context after compaction
body:
Related: #132758

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes fresh CLI turns forgetting the conversation after successful Gateway `sessions.compact`, including stateless `sessionMode: "none"` backends.

## User Impact

The next fresh CLI turn receives the saved compaction summary and retained recent history once, instead of receiving no history. Unknown or mixed-account history remains ineligible for automatic recovery. No configuration or schema migration is required; this does not relabel already-unknown history as trusted.

## Why This Change Was Made

Compaction writes thinking/model bookkeeping before its summary, outside the original CLI writer. The [existing boundary check](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/25933024a1e197fa1a503e84b573a47203fc674f/src/agents/cli-runner/history-boundary.ts#L303-L312) then rejects the changed transcript watermark and stores an unknown boundary.

The CLI history owner now captures a fully covered source before compaction and re-anchors its unchanged account provenance after successful same-transcript compaction and maintenance. The commit checks the original session, writer, lifecycle, provenance and current transcript watermark. It preserves the exact admitted storage target, including legacy session-store markers. There is no alternative replay path or relaxation of the account check.

This restores the documented [CLI recovery contract](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends#sessions) and [compaction view](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/compaction#how-it-works): a saved summary plus retained recent messages, not a second copy of raw pre-compaction history.

## Evidence

Identical isolated Gateway/CLI E2E cells, with two independent repetitions. The fixture uses a loopback OpenAI-compatible summarizer because the synthetic CLI cannot summarize; no external provider or credentials are involved.

| Check | Before: `25933024a1e197fa1a503e84b573a47203fc674f` | After: `eafef138cc674cc8beaa3f93a3b23cc35b4e7250` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sessions.compact` | Successful in both repetitions | Successful in both repetitions |
| Next stateless turn | 666-character prompt, zero history blocks; `NO_PRIOR_CONTEXT_168244` | 1,824-character prompt, one history block; `BLUE_FOLDER_168244` |
| Compacted view | Missing | Complete saved summary once and the service-selected retained assistant turn once; no raw pre-compaction conversation duplicated alongside it |
| Untouched existing-mode control | 1,450 characters, one history block; `BLUE_FOLDER_168244` | Unchanged in both repetitions |
| Uncompacted stateless recall | Covered by #168244 | Both independent sessions recalled `BLUE_FOLDER_168244` in each repetition |
| Gateway health | Healthy | Healthy after both repetitions |

The queued-compaction regression also fails on main `53cfc947f0c6d8c9e2fd8b0a50fb1a5aec89fd17`: a fully covered source stays at sequence 2 instead of the compacted sequence 5. Its foreign-prefix control passes. The candidate's three focused owner suites passed all 49 tests; the five affected regressions passed again after preserving the exact storage-target identity. Direct Oxfmt, Oxlint and whitespace checks passed. The focused tests cover durable and incognito recovery, missing/foreign provenance, writer takeover, cancellation and same-target compaction.

### Authority-chain proof on the exact head

Real isolated Gateway + generic stateless CLI backend, two repetitions per cell, repeated on frozen main `53cfc947f0c6d8c9e2fd8b0a50fb1a5aec89fd17` and candidate `eafef138cc674cc8beaa3f93a3b23cc35b4e7250`. Both build stamps match those SHAs. Each run uses a fresh nonsymlinked state directory, an ephemeral loopback port, synthetic credentials and a loopback-only egress guard.

| Cell | Frozen main (2/2) | Candidate (2/2) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Account A compacts; its next turn is the positive control | 666-character stdin, no summary/history, `NO_PRIOR_CONTEXT_168244` | 1,824-character stdin, saved summary/history, `BLUE_FOLDER_168244` |
| Same agent/backend/session is explicitly reassigned to account B using `sessions.patch` (`ctri-none/fixture@ctri-none:account-b`) | B gets 666-character stdin with neither A's folder marker nor A's compaction marker | Identical exclusion: no `BLUE_FOLDER_168244`, no `COMPACTED_ONCE_168244`, no history block; `NO_PRIOR_CONTEXT_168244` |
| Live reset/compaction race | Reset queues behind the compaction lifecycle fence, then rotates the lifecycle and clears history provenance | Same ordering; after reset there is no history boundary, no intervening CLI backend call, and the next legitimate turn has neither stale marker |
| Retained re-anchor closure guard — **observation-only, not a user path** | Not applicable: main has no re-anchor closure | After real `sessions.reset`, re-invoking the captured production closure rejects with `queued compaction is no longer active`; zero boundary changes and zero CLI backend calls |

**Live race ordering:** the synthetic summarizer holds the real `sessions.compact` request after the source boundary is captured. A concurrent real `sessions.reset` remains queued while compaction owns its exclusive lifecycle fence. Releasing the summarizer allows compaction to finish; reset then rotates `lifecycleRevision` (it intentionally preserves this explicit `sessionId`) and removes `cliHistoryBoundary`. The next legitimate CLI turn returns `NO_PRIOR_CONTEXT_168244`, as on main. This is serialization evidence, not a claim that reset interleaves with re-anchoring.

**Separate retained-work guard:** an observation-only Node loader retains a reference to the actual production re-anchor closure while returning that same closure unchanged to its normal caller. A fixture-only RPC invokes the retained reference after reset. It fails before any boundary mutation or backend I/O in both repetitions. This is a stale-capability guard check, **not a reproduced user-path race**; no production source or built files were changed. The captured built module's SHA-256 is `b6045a65badfdfebcabe4d9d5cfcadf02e72d37d1651bfcf8b22d668b8844be9`.

### Merge danger

Two-way code change using the existing private boundary format. Reverting removes preservation for future compactions without requiring a data migration. The blast radius is CLI history recovery after context-engine compaction; an incorrect boundary could withhold or misattribute context, so source coverage, account provenance and current-writer guards remain mandatory.
